chunks: Abu Abdillah al-Husayn b. Ahmad al-Alawi from the descendants of Muhammad b. Ali b. Abi Talib narrated to us. He said: Abu'l Hasan Ali b. Ahmad b. Musa narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Ali narrated to us. He said: Abu Ali al-Hasan b. Ibrahim b. Ali al-Abbasi narrated to me. He said: Abu Sa'id Umayr b. Mardas al-Dawlaqi narrated to me. He said: Ja'far b. Bashir al-Makki narrated to me. He said: Waki' narrated to us from al-Mas'udi who raised it from Salman al-Farisi (may God have mercy on him). He said:

Iblis passed by a delegation that was taunting the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), so he stood in front of them. The people said: Who is this that stands in front of us? He said: I am Abu Murra. They said: O Abu Murra, do you not hear our words? He said: Curse upon you! You insult your Master Ali b. Abi Talib! They said to him: From where did you learn that he is our Master? He said: From the saying of your Prophet: For whomever I am his Master, then Ali is his Master. O Allah, align with those who align with him, oppose those who oppose him, support those who support him, and abandon those who abandon him.

They said to him: Are you one of those who align with him and his partisans? He said: I am neither of those who align with him nor of his partisans, but I love him, and none hates him except that I become their partner in their wealth and their children. They said to him: O Abu Murra, do you say anything regarding Ali? He said to them: Listen to me, O assembly of oath-breakers, deviators, and apostates.

I worshipped Allah the Mighty and Majestic among the Jinn for twelve thousand years. When Allah destroyed the Jinn, I complained to Allah the Mighty and Majestic about my solitude, so He ascended me to the heaven of this world. I worshipped Allah the Mighty and Majestic in the heaven of this world for twelve more thousand years in the company of the angels. While we were thus glorifying and sanctifying Allah the Mighty and Majestic, a radiant beam of light passed by us. The angels fell in prostration due to that light and said: Glorious and Holy! The light of an Angel of Proximity or a commissioned prophet. Then a call came from the direction of Allah the Mighty and Majestic: This is not the light of an Angel of Proximity nor a commissioned prophet. This is the light of the clay of Ali b. Abi Talib.

key_terms.الناكثين والقاسطين والمارقين: Oath-breakers, deviators, and apostates; the three groups who fought Imam Ali
key_terms.طينة: Clay; the pre-material substance from which Ali was formed
key_terms.مولى: Master/guardian (mawla); the central term of the Ghadir declaration
key_terms.نور شعشعاني: Radiant/dazzling light; describing the celestial light of Ali's clay

ai.seo_question: What did Iblis (Satan) say about Imam Ali at Ghadir Khumm and the light of Ali's clay?
ai.summary: In this remarkable narrative, Iblis (Satan, also known as Abu Murra) encounters a group that was speaking ill of Imam Ali (AS). Iblis rebukes them, citing the Prophet's famous Ghadir Khumm declaration about Ali being the master (mawla) of believers. While Iblis clarifies he is not Ali's follower, he admits to loving Ali and warns that anyone who hates Ali becomes Iblis's partner in their wealth and children. Iblis then recounts his ancient history: he worshipped Allah for 12,000 years among the Jinn, then after the Jinn's destruction, worshipped for another 12,000 years among the angels in the lowest heaven, where he witnessed the pre-eternal radiant light of Ali's clay, before which even the angels prostrated.
